title: Velo Cherry Ice Mini Nicotine Pouches - Mellow (6mg)
description: Velo Mini Cherry Ice Nicotine Pouches combine the bold, fruity taste of ripe Cherry with a cooling note that adds freshness and balance. The combination of sweetness and cooling character gives Cherry Ice a clear and appealing profile. Each can contains 15 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released gradually without smoke, vapour or odour, making them a convenient option wherever you are. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide range of flavours and strengths. Velo Mini cans contain 15 pouches, and this Cherry Ice edition is offered in a Mild 6mg nicotine strength. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
